description.en: The ID of the instance group to which the application is deployed.

description.zh:
可不传或指定规则类型：
- SCALE\_IN表示缩容。
- SCALE\_OUT表示扩容。
description.en:
The type of the scaling rule. You can leave this parameter empty. Valid values:

- SCALE\_IN: scale-in rules

- SCALE\_OUT: scale-out rules

example.unifiedCli: aliyun edas get-scaling-rules --app-id 33e39be9-3e5f-000000000 --group-id d8bb9d60-900000000000000 --biz-mode SCALE_IN --region cn-hangzhou
